title: He Said Goodbye The Day We MET 📦
description:
The day I moved in, my new neighbor Vern hugged me on my lawn, cried, and thanked me for thirty years.

Vern lives backward. His porch calendar counts down every morning, and every year he gets a little younger.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment WAVE if you'd still be his friend.
